components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; margin-top: 32px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFFFFF 0%, #DCE3EC 100%); border-radius: 14px; box-shadow: 0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.6); color: #0B1220; font: 400 1.0625rem/1.6 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-badge { position: absolute; top: -28px; left: 50%; width: 56px; height: 56px; margin-left: -28px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2A9DFF, #0A6FD6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #fff, 0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); } .ds-badge svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; fill: none; stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-card-head { margin: 0; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0F6BD0, #0B4FA3); color: #fff; text-align: center; padding: 2.1rem 1rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0; font: 800 2.1rem/1 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-steps { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-steps li { padding: 1rem 1.5rem; } .ds-steps li:nth-child(even) { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); } .ds-steps li + li { border-top: 1px solid #C3CFDF; } .ds-steps strong { display: block; font: 800 1.15rem/1.1 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: #07162B; } .ds-steps span { display: block; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.4; color: #4A566B; margin-top: 0.2rem; } .ds-card-foot { margin: 0; padding: 0.9rem 1.5rem 1.1rem; border-top: 1px solid #C3CFDF; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #E4EAF2, #D2DAE6); border-radius: 0 0 14px 14px; font: 700 0.95rem/1.3 Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #07162B; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads as the control surface of modern manufacturing software, with no machine photography. A deep navy field carries the hero, top bar and footer. Content lives on brushed-steel and white panels that sit on a pale blue-grey ground, capped by blue gradient header bands. Electric blue is the one voice: a single emphasized headline word, the wordmark's "Solutions", hover, and every focus ring.

Density is moderate and plain. Everything sits in a 1120px column. Each topic is one rounded panel with a blue band on top; the hero pairs a caps headline with a steel How it works card that carries a cloud badge. The direction came from the user's reference mockup ("Industrial blue") and replaced an earlier green safety-signage world entirely.
keyCharacteristics: Navy (#07162B) bookends the page (top bar, hero, footer); the working body is a cool grey-blue ground (#E9EEF4).
Electric blue (#2A9DFF) is rare: one headline word, wordmark accent, focus ring, nav hover on navy.
White-to-steel gradients and blue gradient bands give a brushed, machined surface without photography.
Barlow 800 uppercase for every heading and label; Barlow 400 to 600 for messages.
Diagonal blue facets on the left edge of the hero and page title on wide screens only.
Soft navy shadows and 6 to 14px radii; no hard edges and no heavy borders.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Electric blue appears on one headline word per page plus focus and hover. If a second thing wants electric blue, it takes brand blue or white instead.

rules.name: The Fleet Is Electric-Deep Rule
rules.body: Fleet in the plan table is identified by electric deep (#0A6FD6) and its wash; Individual stays navy 2. Do not recolor the columns.

rules.name: The Blue Band Rule
rules.body: A new content topic is a white panel under the blue band gradient; it does not get a new header color.

rules.name: The Caps Are Headings Rule
rules.body: Uppercase Barlow 800 is for headings, labels and buttons; messages are sentence case at 400 to 600.

rules.name: The Ramp Rule
rules.body: Reuse a size above before adding a new one.

rules.name: The Soft Navy Rule
rules.body: Shadows are diffuse and navy-tinted on light grounds, black on navy. No hard-offset shadows.

dos: Do put electric blue (#2A9DFF) on one headline word and on focus rings.
Do build new topics as white 12px panels under the blue band gradient (#0F6BD0 to #0B4FA3).
Do keep headings in Barlow 800 uppercase and messages in Barlow 400 to 600 sentence case.
Do keep text on navy white or one of the on-navy tints, and verify contrast on gradients.
Do keep the facets wide-screen only and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't return to the green safety-signage world: Barlow Condensed, green bands, 2px ink edges, or a hanging tag with an eyelet.
Don't add machine photography or stock imagery.
Don't use hard-offset shadows or heavy borders; depth is soft and navy.
Don't introduce a second accent hue beside blue.
Don't make a new surface a generic light SaaS feature-card grid.
